summary: Ferrari N.V. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release on its ongoing share buyback program — the second tranche of a multi-year ~€3.5bn program expected to be executed by 2030. The filing details daily repurchases on Euronext Milan and NYSE from May 4-8, 2026: total 73,191 shares at an average price of ~€287.44/share (consideration ~€21.04mn). As of May 8, the company held 17,634,681 treasury shares (9.09% of issued common; 9.45% of total capital, including special voting shares). The board has approved a cancellation of treasury shares (pending effectiveness), further enhancing per-share metrics. Watch for execution pace amid market conditions; no risk-arb angle as this is a straight capital return program.
